reader_active_english.title: From lot records to the next operating decision
reader_active_english.lead: For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, progress and quality information becomes useful when the source, scope and decision owner are clear.
reader_active_english.figure: Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.
reader_active_english.s1p1: Choose one production lot and the planning decision that needs its progress or quality status. Identify the source record, when it was updated, and what it covers.
reader_active_english.s1p2: Agree who checks a mismatch, who receives the confirmed information and what evidence they need before the next step.
reader_active_english.s2h: Keep planning and production evidence in their roles
reader_active_english.s2p1: ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.
reader_active_english.s2p2: Map the information each team needs before defining the solution scope and data handoff.
reader_active_english.s3p1: Wafer Works / 合晶科技, Taiwan / Shanghai, produces silicon wafer materials. The case covers crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.
reader_active_english.s3p2: Digiwin describes production genealogy from silicon crystals to wafer lots, visibility into production progress and equipment status, and epitaxy history with quality parameter limits.
reader_active_english.s3p3: For an equipment-component supplier, these are useful questions about traceability and execution visibility to bring into its own process discussion.
reader_active_english.s4h: Define the fit with the team in Vietnam
reader_active_english.s4p1: Digiwin Vietnam specialists assess factory operations, advise on business processes and support on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.
reader_active_english.s4p2: Bring a current production-to-planning handoff to the discussion: its records, the people involved, the receiving decision and the gaps to resolve. This helps define the processes and implementation scope for your factory.
